positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Rightworks makes it easy for accounting firms and small businesses to securely work and collaborate in QuickBooks—and other accounting, tax and business apps—anytime, anywhere.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Verisk Extreme Event Solutions provides risk modeling solutions that help individuals, businesses, and society become more resilient to extreme events.  In 1987, Verisk founded the catastrophe modeling industry.

Full stack engineering with Angular/Microsoft stack, building cloud-native geospatial solutions.  Spearheaded adoption of the `OGC API - Features` standard within my product team.
positions.insights: Skills: GeoServer · Software Design · OpenLayers · GDAL · Okta Administration · Infrastructure as code (IaC) · E2E · .NET Core · C# · Agile Development · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Docker · PostGIS · PostgreSQL · Python (Programming Language) · Angular

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Rightworks is a leading provider of hosting of the most popular accounting applications like QuickBooks, Lacerte, ProSeries and Drake software.

Contributed to all aspects of external customer facing web-based applications as well as internal systems and tools. Took the lead in building various data systems to support company goals (database integrity, system sync audits between internal and external systems, etc).

Full stack engineering with Angular/Microsoft stack.
positions.insights: Skills: SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) · Azure Active Directory · Infrastructure as code (IaC) · C# · Agile Development · Zuora · Microsoft SQL Server · Microsoft Azure · Angular

positions.title: Senior Developer
positions.description: Company agent responsible for the New Hampshire branch office

positions.title: Developer / Analyst
positions.description:
Federal contracting - primarily working with the US EPA Clean Air Markets Division.

At this small company, I had the opportunity to be involved with many different activities including software development (C#, WPF), database development (PL/SQL, ETL, logical and physical database design), systems administration (Azure, VMware, Hyper-V, RHEL, Windows), and database administration (Oracle and SQL Server DBA experience).  I obtained a position of public trust (SF85P) security clearance while in this role.

positions.title: GIS Analyst
positions.description: This was a position in VDOT’s IT Division.  I maintained the Road Centerline dataset and created Virginia’s first enterprise Interstate Exits dataset.

positions.title: GIS Technician
positions.description: I held an entry level position in the technology division of a major civil engineering company where I was responsible for manual data entry (field GPS data collection, aerial photo interpretation, data QC efforts). I worked on a variety of projects in municipal and regional utilities (water, power, transportation, E911 system implementation).
